pages.text:
The Chemical Reactor reacts an item and up to two fluids into an item, a fluid, or both. Two input tanks, one output tank, an item slot in and an item slot out, plus a byproduct slot.
# Sulfur
- Crush gunpowder (2 Sulfur Dust each), netherrack (sometimes a Sulfur Dust) or Nether Sulfur Ore, found through the Nether.
- Sulfur Dust + 500 mB Water makes 500 mB Sulfuric Acid.
# Leaching (×3)
- Raw ore + 250 mB Sulfuric Acid makes 300 mB of that metal's Slurry. An ore block takes 500 mB and makes 600 mB; a raw ore block, 2,250 and 2,700.
- Works for iron, copper, gold, silver, nickel, tungsten and bismuth. Fluorite and arcite are gems and aren't leached.
# Precipitating
- 100 mB Slurry + 100 mB Water makes one dust, with a small chance of Slag.
- So a raw ore gives 3 dust and an ore block 6, against 2 and 4 from the Arc Crushing Array.
# Setting up
Fluids go into whichever input tank already holds them, otherwise the empty one. Run one reactor for acid, one for leaching and one for precipitating, joined with fluid conduits.
# Plastic
- 100 mB Light Oil + 50 mB Hydrogen makes 2 Plastic Sheets.
